# PhysioNutra Clinic — Best Physiotherapy in Chandigarh Tricity & Online Consultations Worldwide

> Dr Tarun's PhysioNutra Clinic is a physiotherapy and rehabilitation centre led by Dr. Tarun Garg, Senior Physiotherapist with 10+ years of clinical experience and 5,000+ patients treated. We provide in-clinic and home physiotherapy across Chandigarh Tricity (Zirakpur, Chandigarh, Mohali, Panchkula, Kharar), and **online video consultations worldwide** for patients in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia, UAE, and beyond. Our clinic is equipped with advanced rehabilitation equipment and operates on an evidence-based, drug-free, one-on-one care model. 4.9★ Google Rating.

## About PhysioNutra Clinic

- **Clinic Name:** PhysioNutra Clinic (also known as Dr Tarun's PhysioNutra Clinic®)
- **Lead Physiotherapist:** Dr. Tarun Garg, Senior Physiotherapist
- **Specialities:** Musculoskeletal Physiotherapy, Sports Rehabilitation, Neurological Rehabilitation, Post-Surgical Rehabilitation, Nutritional Counseling
- **Approach:** Evidence-based, drug-free, one-on-one patient care
- **Patients Treated:** 5,000+
- **Google Rating:** 4.9/5
- **Languages:** English, Hindi, Punjabi

## Online Video Consultations (Worldwide)

We provide one-on-one telehealth physiotherapy consultations to patients anywhere in the world over Zoom, Google Meet, or WhatsApp Video. Sessions focus on assessment through movement screening, guided self-tests, detailed history, and personalised exercise and self-management plans.

### Pricing
- **Standard session** (booked 24+ hours in advance): **USD 35** (~£28 GBP / ~C$48 CAD / ~A$52 AUD / ~AED 129)
- **Same-day / Emergency session:** **USD 50** (~£40 GBP / ~C$70 CAD / ~A$75 AUD / ~AED 184)
- Billed in USD via secure payment link; local-currency estimates shown at booking.

### Transparency Notes for International Patients
Dr. Tarun Garg is a Senior Physiotherapist based in India. He is not licensed by US state boards, UK HCPC, Canadian provincial colleges, Australian AHPRA, or UAE DHA/DOH/MOHAP. We do not bill insurance (Medicare, Medicaid, Bupa, AXA, Sun Life, Manulife, Daman, NAS, Cigna, etc.) — we operate on a transparent direct-pay cash model. For conditions strictly requiring hands-on manual therapy, we honestly advise patients to seek local in-person care.
